By
Lemma <REF_0002>

of <MATH_0003>. On the other hand
Lemmas <REF_0003> and <REF_0004>

Let <MATH_0001> be an algebraic stack. Let <MATH_0002> be an algebraic space and

open immersion <MATH_0006>, and a surjective smooth
morphism <MATH_0007>.
